about: C1a Shell chrome: the tab bar (frame menu, pooled host type 3) always visible, not only with the laser (WN §3.3.5, PLAN §1.17 S9).
Behind the flag tabBarAlways (off until AT-7 passes; V1 turns it on in device/defaults.json). Its depth (+25 mm) is P7's tabBarDepth rule in theme/sg/00-base.json, so no zMm here.
